author: DropTrack
description: Analyze tracks, find submission opportunities, and manage music-promotion workflows through your DropTrack account.
name: DropTrack

tools.name: droptrack_get_runtime_context
tools.description: Attest the connected DropTrack MCP stage, base URL, non-secret database fingerprint, configured database-target match, Lambda identity, region, and authorization role. Call this before any write. Require databaseTargetMatchesExpected=true, compare stage, base URL, and fingerprint to the canonical environment table, then pass the exact stage and database fingerprint to guarded write tools. Never infer environment from company data alone.

tools.name: droptrack_list_tracks
tools.description: List tracks in the current company with play, download, and view counts. Returns paginated results and, when the library is empty, guidance for requesting an audio file or Spotify/SoundCloud link.

tools.name: droptrack_get_track_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific track including all versions, genre, key, and audio URLs.

trackId.description: The track ID to get details for

tools.name: droptrack_get_track_analytics
tools.description: Get track analytics (plays, downloads, views) over a date range. Optionally scope results to a specific track version.

versionId.description: Optional track version ID to filter analytics to a single version

tools.name: droptrack_get_comments
tools.description: Get timestamped comments for a track, across a playlist, or within a campaign.

scopeId.description: Track ID, playlist ID, or campaign ID matching scopeType

versionId.description: Optional track version ID when scopeType is track

tools.name: droptrack_get_track_downloads
tools.description: Get download history for a track — who downloaded, format, version, and when.

versionId.description: Optional track version ID to filter downloads to a single version

tools.name: droptrack_list_campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns in the current company with status and basic engagement stats (opens, plays, downloads, feedback count).

tools.name: droptrack_get_campaign_details
tools.description: Get full campaign details, including subject, playlist identity and track count, saved and actual recipient counts, status, Reply-To email, creator test-recipient email, and settings.

tools.name: droptrack_validate_campaign_draft
tools.description: Read-only preflight for a campaign draft before using DropTrack Send Test. Requires the expected playlist and contact list, supports normalized-email exclusions from linked lists and exact saved recipient snapshots from prior campaigns, and verifies draft state, audience persistence, subject, optional signoff, Reply-To/test-recipient routing, and outbound U+2014 em-dash safety. This tool does not send email or launch the campaign.

expectedPlaylistId.description: The playlist ID the draft must contain

expectedContactListId.description: The contact list ID the draft must contain

expectedExcludedContactListIds.description: Linked contact list IDs whose normalized-email members must be absent from the saved draft audience

expectedExcludedCampaignIds.description: Prior campaign IDs whose exact saved recipient snapshots must be absent from the saved draft audience

expectedSignoff.description: Optional exact signoff text that must appear in the message

tools.name: droptrack_get_campaign_analytics
tools.description: Get per-contact engagement analytics for a campaign — opens, plays, downloads, and feedback for each recipient.

tools.name: droptrack_get_campaign_nudge_summary
tools.description: Get CRM nudge settings, funnel totals, stuck-contact buckets, sent nudge history, and weekly digest state for a campaign.

tools.name: droptrack_list_campaign_nudge_contacts
tools.description: List recipients in a campaign with CRM nudge signal state, sent nudges, next scheduled nudge, and reply suppression status.

search.description: Optional search term for contact name, email, or company

tools.name: droptrack_create_draft_campaign
tools.description: Create and read back a complete Draft-status campaign without sending it. Supports customer-owned and linked DropTrack-managed contact lists, persists a required subject/message, exact playlist, active subscribed recipients, creator identity, theme, and settings, and can exclude normalized-email members of linked lists or exact saved recipient snapshots from prior campaigns. Use campaign exclusions for historical no-repeat guarantees. Rejects U+2014 em dashes. Run droptrack_validate_campaign_draft before opening the native Send Test flow.

expectedStage.description: Intended DropTrack environment from droptrack_get_runtime_context; use prod only for production

expectedDatabaseFingerprint.description: Exact non-secret database fingerprint returned by droptrack_get_runtime_context

playlistId.description: Active playlist ID containing the tracks to send

contactListId.description: Contact list ID whose active subscribed members become saved draft recipients

excludeContactListIds.description: Other linked contact list IDs whose normalized-email members must be excluded from this draft audience

excludeCampaignIds.description: Prior campaign IDs whose exact saved recipient snapshots must be excluded by normalized email; use this for historical no-repeat guarantees

campaignSubject.description: Required recipient-facing email subject; U+2014 is rejected

campaignMessage.description: Required recipient-facing message; U+2014 is rejected

themeId.description: Built-in or company-owned active campaign theme ID

tools.name: droptrack_search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by name, email, or company.

search.description: Search term for name, email, or company

tools.name: droptrack_list_contact_lists
tools.description: List all contact lists for the current company with the number of contacts in each list.

tools.name: droptrack_get_contact_details
tools.description: Get the full profile of a specific contact including subscription status.

tools.name: droptrack_get_contact_nudge_context
tools.description: Get CRM nudge context for one contact: active campaigns watching the contact and recent automated nudges sent for that contact.

limit.description: Maximum campaigns and sent nudges to return

tools.name: droptrack_add_contact
tools.description: Add a new contact to the current company.

slug.description: Optional public contact-link slug; generated from contact details when omitted

tools.name: droptrack_create_contact_list
tools.description: Create a new contact list in the current company.

name.description: Name for the new contact list

tools.name: droptrack_add_contacts_to_list
tools.description: Add one or more contacts to an existing contact list.

contactIds.description: Array of contact IDs to add

tools.name: droptrack_list_playlists
tools.description: List all playlists in the current company with track counts.

tools.name: droptrack_get_playlist_details
tools.description: Get full playlist details including tracks, feedback, and view/download/feedback stats.

tools.name: droptrack_list_companies
tools.description: List all companies the authenticated user belongs to. Useful for users with multiple label/company accounts. Company switching must be performed through the authenticated client/session, not through a model-visible tool.

tools.name: droptrack_list_assets
tools.description: List company assets: uploaded/AI images or documents.

sourceType.description: Optional image source filter when assetType is image

targetId.description: Optional track or playlist ID when targetType is provided

playlistId.description: Optional playlist ID when assetType is document

tools.name: droptrack_list_ad_campaigns
tools.description: List Grow/ads campaigns for the current company with budget, delivery, landing page, and creative counts.

status.description: Optional ads campaign status filter such as draft, active, live, paused, completed, or failed

promotionType.description: Optional promotion type filter such as spotify, droptrack, or artist

tools.name: droptrack_get_ad_campaign_details
tools.description: Get details for a Grow/ads campaign, including landing page, creatives, and recent daily metrics.

tools.name: droptrack_get_ad_analytics
tools.description: Get Grow/ads daily analytics over a date range. Returns company totals or a single campaign when campaignId is supplied.

tools.name: droptrack_get_ads_wallet
tools.description: Get the current company ads wallet balance and recent wallet transactions.

tools.name: droptrack_get_label_info
tools.description: Get label-family metadata for the active company, including parent label, sub-accounts visible to label admins, and shared wallet status.

labelCompanyId.description: Admin-only override: label company ID to inspect

tools.name: droptrack_list_label_artists
tools.description: List artist sub-accounts under the active label. Requires label-admin access.

tools.name: droptrack_list_label_team
tools.description: List users with access to the label parent and artist sub-accounts. Requires label-admin access.

tools.name: droptrack_list_label_contacts
tools.description: List contacts across the label family, with label versus artist ownership annotations.

artistIds.description: Optional comma-separated company IDs to scope contacts to; omit or use all for the whole visible family

tools.name: droptrack_get_label_analytics
tools.description: Get cross-roster label analytics over a date range: totals, artist rollups, top tracks, and top contacts. Requires label-admin access.

artistIds.description: Optional comma-separated artist company IDs; omit or use all for all artists

tools.name: droptrack_get_label_contact_360
tools.description: Get one contact cross-roster engagement timeline and per-artist breakdown. Requires label-admin access.

tools.name: droptrack_list_label_ad_campaigns
tools.description: List Grow/ads campaigns across a label family, optionally scoped to artists or date range. Requires label-admin access.

artistIds.description: Optional comma-separated company IDs; omit or use all for the whole label family

tools.name: droptrack_get_label_ad_analytics
tools.description: Get cross-roster Grow/ads analytics over a date range. Requires label-admin access.

artistIds.description: Optional comma-separated company IDs; omit or use all for the whole label family

tools.name: droptrack_get_label_ads_wallet
tools.description: Get the label shared ads wallet balance and recent transactions. Requires label-admin access.

tools.name: droptrack_set_label_shared_wallet
tools.description: Enable or disable the label shared ads wallet. Requires label-admin access and confirms disabling when active sub-account ads exist.

enabled.description: Whether shared ads wallet spend should be enabled for the label

confirmDisable.description: Set true to confirm disabling when active sub-account ads exist

tools.name: droptrack_get_artist_profile
tools.description: Get the current company artist profile used by the AI artist bio feature, including bio, socials, genres, recent tracks, and recent generated bio jobs.

tools.name: droptrack_get_user_notification_settings
tools.description: Get the authenticated user email notification settings, including weekly/monthly reports, engagement emails, and campaign nudge email updates.

tools.name: droptrack_generate_press_release
tools.description: Queue an AI press release draft for a track owned by the authenticated company. Use droptrack_get_ai_job with jobType=press_release to poll the result.

trackId.description: Track ID to generate a press release for

providerUrl.description: Optional Spotify/SoundCloud/provider URL used as additional release context

inputMode.description: Optional source mode label, such as uploaded_file, spotify, or soundcloud

tools.name: droptrack_generate_artist_bio
tools.description: Queue an AI artist bio draft for the authenticated company. Poll with droptrack_get_ai_job using jobType=artist_bio.

tools.name: droptrack_generate_album_art
tools.description: Queue AI album artwork generation for a track or playlist. Use droptrack_get_ai_job with jobType=album_art to poll candidate images, then droptrack_accept_album_art_candidate to save one.

targetType.description: Generate artwork for a track or playlist

style.description: Visual style for the generated artwork

count.description: Number of candidate images to request

sourceImageId.description: Optional existing image ID to use as source context

metadata.description: Optional metadata overrides such as title, artist, genre, bpm, key, mood, or lyrics

tools.name: droptrack_get_ai_job
tools.description: Poll a queued AI job: press release, artist bio, or album art.

messageId.description: Message ID returned by the generate tool

jobId.description: Album art job ID, optional when messageId is provided

tools.name: droptrack_list_ai_jobs
tools.description: List recent AI jobs for press releases, artist bios, or album art.

trackId.description: Optional track filter for press_release jobs

targetType.description: Optional target filter for album_art jobs

targetId.description: Optional target ID filter for album_art jobs

status.description: Optional status filter for album_art jobs

tools.name: droptrack_accept_album_art_candidate
tools.description: Save an AI album artwork candidate from droptrack_get_ai_job as a reusable DropTrack image and optionally assign it to the target track or playlist.

candidateId.description: Candidate ID returned by droptrack_get_ai_job for an album_art job

targetType.description: Target type that will receive the saved image

assign.description: Whether to assign the saved image to the target immediately

tools.name: droptrack_delete_album_art_image
tools.description: Soft-delete an AI-generated album artwork image and unassign it from tracks or playlists owned by the authenticated company.

tools.name: droptrack_get_track_analysis
tools.description: Read existing structured analyzer output for a track or track version, with optional post-upload workflow status and personalized submission opportunities. This does not queue or apply AI track tags.

trackVersionId.description: Optional track version ID to prioritize

includeRaw.description: Include raw analyzer payloads in addition to structured output

statusOnly.description: Return a compact readiness/status view for post-upload polling

includeOpportunities.description: Also return personalized submission opportunities for this track

opportunitiesPerType.description: Maximum opportunities to return per category

tools.name: droptrack_create_audio_analysis_upload
tools.description: Create an authenticated short-lived S3 upload URL for a WAV, MP3, AIF, or AIFF file, enforcing track/version plan limits before upload.

fileName.description: Original audio filename, such as song.wav or demo.aiff

contentType.description: Audio MIME type, such as audio/wav, audio/mpeg, or audio/aiff

fileSizeBytes.description: Optional client-side file size for validation

trackId.description: Existing DropTrack track ID when the upload will become a new track version

tools.name: droptrack_analyze_audio
tools.description: Analyze a WAV, MP3, AIF, AIFF, SoundCloud URL, or Spotify track URL directly through MCP and return structured analysis. No browser analyzer visit is required.

uploadKey.description: upload_key returned by droptrack_create_audio_analysis_upload after the client PUTs the file

trackId.description: Existing DropTrack track ID. When provided, uploaded audio is saved as a new active track version instead of a new track

s3Url.description: S3 URL for an uploaded audio file, such as s3://bucket/key

audioUrl.description: Direct HTTPS audio URL. S3 URLs are preferred for private uploads

audioBase64.description: Inline base64 audio for small files only

providerUrl.description: Spotify track URL/URI or SoundCloud URL

fileName.description: Filename used to infer audio type when needed

contentType.description: Optional audio MIME type used when the source does not provide one

title.description: Optional track title used when creating a new DropTrack track

artist.description: Optional artist name used when creating a new DropTrack track

versionLabel.description: Optional label when trackId is provided and a new version is created

analysisTimeoutMs.description: Optional maximum milliseconds to wait for synchronous analysis before returning the saved track and polling instructions

includeOpportunities.description: Return personalized submission opportunities derived from the analysis genres

accountTypes.description: Submission opportunity categories to return with the analysis

opportunitiesPerType.description: Maximum submission opportunities to return per account type

tools.name: droptrack_get_track_tags
tools.description: Read stored AI track-tagging output from the dedicated tag_audio workflow. This is separate from track analyzer output.

tools.name: droptrack_browse_submission_opportunities
tools.description: Browse the public DropTrack submission directory for labels, DJs, bloggers, and playlist curators.

genreSlugs.description: Optional public directory genre slugs, such as house, pop, hip-hop, or indie

guaranteedListen.description: Only include opportunities with guaranteed listen/payment enabled

tools.name: droptrack_get_track_submission_opportunities
tools.description: Return structured promotion/submission opportunities personalized for one track: record labels, DJs, bloggers, and playlist curators.

trackId.description: Track ID to match against DropTrack submission opportunities

accountTypes.description: Submission opportunity categories to match against the track

limitPerType.description: Maximum matched opportunities to return per account type

guaranteedListen.description: Only return opportunities with guaranteed listen or paid-feedback options

tools.name: droptrack_request_track_tagging
tools.description: Queue the dedicated tag_audio workflow for one track. Poll with droptrack_get_track_tags.

force.description: Queue fresh tagging even if stored tags already exist

tools.name: droptrack_auto_tag_tracks
tools.description: Apply stored AI track-tagging results to track metadata, matching the dedicated batch_auto_tag endpoint behavior.

autoUntagged.description: When trackIds is empty, find recent untagged tracks for the active company

queueMissing.description: Queue tag_audio for tracks without stored tags instead of failing them

limit.description: Maximum tracks when autoUntagged is true
